knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "First Hawaiian Bank was founded in 1858 and is Hawaii's largest bank. First Hawaiian is a full-service financial institution offering consumer and business banking services, online banking, deposits, lo ns, credit cards, mortgages, wealth management, trust, investment and insurance products. The bank has 48 branches throughout Hawaii, three in Guam and one in Saipan."
